rabbi-yehuda-nesia.name: Rabbi Yehuda Nesia
rabbi-yehuda-nesia.bio: Grandson of Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi, who succeeded his father, Rabban Gamliel, as Nasi.
rabbi-yehuda-nesia.prompt: A dignified patriarch of the Jewish community in his 50s with a well-kept dark beard and fine, richly woven robes of office, with a composed, inquiring expression; background of limestone arches and olive trees.

rav-sheizevi.name: Rav Sheizevi
rav-sheizevi.bio: Babylonian Amora, cited here transmitting a ruling of Rav Huna.
rav-sheizevi.prompt: A quiet, attentive Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a short dark beard and a steady, faithful expression, as if repeating his teacher's words; background of mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps.

rabbi-shmuel-bar-natan.name: Rabbi Shmuel bar Natan
rabbi-shmuel-bar-natan.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel, cited here transmitting a ruling of Rabbi Ḥanina.
rabbi-shmuel-bar-natan.prompt: A thoughtful scholar of the Land of Israel in his 40s with a dark beard and a careful, precise expression; background of limestone arches and olive trees.
